permit.applies: The foreign national, on their own behalf or through an employer registered in Türkiye, in the Ministry's e-exemption system; the work permit's applicant wasn't read.
permit.first: A signed employment contract between the performer and the employer; from abroad, the performer first applies at a Turkish mission and passes the 16-digit reference number to the employer, who files the application on e-İzin within 30 days.

permit.eligibility: Bilimsel, kültürel ve sanatsal faaliyetler kapsamında çalışacak yabancılar
permit.pay: For a work permit the wage may not be below the gross minimum wage in force at application, rising to twice it for work requiring expertise or mastery, three times for other managers, four times for engineers and architects and five times for senior managers and pilots (the Ministry's evaluation criteria, 3.1).
